cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team.
[Company name masked]'s Data & Analytics function is focused on creating and deploying capabilities to drive business results for our clients. The team is comprised of data scientists, data engineers, technical business analytics consultants, and product managers who work together to solve some of the most challenging business problems our clients have. We drive the full analytics life cycle on client engagements: scoping and understanding business challenges, developing and maintaining robust data assets, creating and running innovative analytical techniques, generating compelling visualizations to communicate the findings / recommendations. We build, develop, and maintain innovative tools and applications for use across projects and for specific clients. We coach, mentor and train colleagues from across the business, on everything from what types of commercial problems analytical techniques can help solve to in-depth technical training for specific types of analysis.
This role is for a Senior Data Scientist on [Company name masked]'s rapidly growing Data & Analytics team. The primary focus of this role is to provide technical expertise: helping to execute on complex analytics across a wide variety of often fast-paced client engagements, helping to build innovative tools and applications that can help solve client's commercial issues, helping to execute cutting edge analytical techniques, helping to drive technical roadmaps for the function and firm, and training our colleagues.
As part of a dynamic and growing team, there is every opportunity to carve out value added work, and to grow your skills and experience. You receive state-of-the-art training in a variety of domains, and lead the organization to adopting new and innovative methods to solve our clients' hardest questions. You won't just be a technical expert: you will intersect between data science, and commercial business understanding, across a variety of domains to provide analytically driven recommendations to our clients.
Data & Analytics is one of four key pillars to the Solutions Team at [Company name masked], alongside Market Insights, Information & Research Center and Knowledge Management. The Solutions team works together to support and enable our consulting team members to generate best in class insights for our clients.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Client engagements:
Lead end-to-end data science projects from conceptualization through to deployment, and deploy advanced machine learning models in clients' cloud environments, optimizing for scalability, performance, and reliability to address specific business challenges and objectives
Support clients in strategically leveraging technical models, guiding them through the interpretation of results and the integration of actionable insights into their business workflows
Solve a wide variety of complex analytical challenges for clients, sometimes dynamically balancing multiple client engagements at one time
Analytical needs can include: data aggregation / creation, data cleaning / manipulation, commercial data science (e.g., geospatial, machine learning, predictive modelling, NLP, GenAI etc.), and visualizations
Help drive the technical roadmap needed to support client engagements
Analytical apps, service lines, and proprietary data assets:
Drive the development of state-of-the-art analytical apps, leveraging up-to-date in machine learning algorithms to solve complex problems
Collaborate with a variety of stakeholders to continuously innovate on the apps, service lines and proprietary data assets we can offer
Provide technical expertise and thought leadership on developing analytical tools, services lines, and proprietary data assets, and contribute to building these areas directly when applicable
Uphold best-in-class standards in app development, data integrity, and ensuring solutions are both scalable and maintainable
Client / business development:
When relevant, support Managing Directors in developing and delivering client proposals where advanced data and analytics are critical to the scope of work
Provide input into training / upskilling the D&A team provides to Managing Directors to ensure they are aware of all of our most current capabilities
Capability development:
Stay up to date on best-in-class software, tools, and techniques to ensure that we are able to provide clients with best-in-class solutions
Support commercialization and upskilling of staff on relevant software, tools and techniques
Help drive the technical roadmap to ensure we are operating a best-in-class Data & Analytics function
Mentor team members, contribute to technical capabilities of the team
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
A minimum of 4 years of experience in applied data science with a solid foundation in machine learning, statistical modeling, and analysis
Strong knowledge, experience, and fluency in a wide variety of tools including Python with data science and machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), Spark, SQL
Technical understanding of machine learning algorithms; experience with deriving insights by performing data science techniques including classification models, clustering analysis, time-series modeling, NLP
Expertise in developing and deploying machine learning models in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) with a deep understanding of cloud services, architecture, and scalable solutions (e.g., Sagemaker, Azure ML, Kubernetes, Airflow)
Demonstrated experience with MLOps practices, including continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) for ML, model versioning, monitoring, and performance tracking to ensure models are efficiently updated and maintained in production environments
Hands-on experience with manipulating and extracting information on a variety of large both structured and unstructured datasets; comfort with best data acquisition and warehousing practices
Proficient Excel, PowerPoint presentation and excellent communication skills, both written and oral; ability to explain complex algorithms to business stakeholders
Ability to achieve results through others; experience and proven success record working in matrix, agile and fast-growing environments; and assertive, intellectually curious and continuously driving towards excellence
Preferred Requirements:
Degree in a quantitative and/or business discipline, examples include: Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics
Familiarity with Alteryx and Tableau
Technical knowledge of optimization
Experience with commercial business analytics; experience at a consulting firm / agency
Candidates responding to this posting must currently possess eligibility to work in [Location masked].
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value contributing in ways that are helpful, responsible, and considerate of others. We believe the quality of our work includes how well it serves people and how fairly it is carried out.
cond_0001.inclusion: Fostering a global inclusive workplace reflects [Company name masked]'s core values and business philosophy and is essential for our future success. Our commitment to global inclusive workplace allows us to create an environment where every employee, regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, race, ethnicity, nationality, political affiliation, or sexual orientation, can bring their unique perspective and experiences to work, enabling us to drive profitability, increase productivity, and unleash innovation. We strive to create a workplace that is equitable and accessible to all employees.
cond_0001.workplace_support: We know there is no one-size-fits-all approach to work. That is why we support flexibility while also creating opportunities for people to connect, build community, and feel a sense of belonging at work.

cond_0017.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join [Company name masked]'s Data & Analytics team.
[Company name masked]'s Data & Analytics function is focused on creating and deploying capabilities to drive business results for clients. The team is comprised of data scientists, data engineers, technical business analytics consultants, and product managers who work together to solve some of the most challenging business problems clients have. The team drives the full analytics life cycle on client engagements: scoping and understanding business challenges, developing and maintaining robust data assets, creating and running innovative analytical techniques, generating compelling visualizations to communicate findings and recommendations. The team builds, develops, and maintains innovative tools and applications for use across projects and for specific clients. The team also coaches, mentors and trains colleagues from across the business, on everything from what types of commercial problems analytical techniques can help solve to in-depth technical training for specific types of analysis.
The primary focus of this role is to provide technical expertise: executing on complex analytics across a wide variety of client engagements, building innovative tools and applications that help solve clients' commercial issues, executing cutting edge analytical techniques, driving technical roadmaps for the function and firm, and training colleagues.
There is every opportunity to carve out value-added work and grow your skills and experience. You will receive training in a variety of domains and lead the organization in adopting new and innovative methods to solve clients' hardest questions. You will intersect between data science and commercial business understanding, across a variety of domains, to deliver analytically driven recommendations to clients.
Data & Analytics is one of four key pillars to the Solutions Team at [Company name masked], alongside Market Insights, Information & Research Center and Knowledge Management.
cond_0017.responsibilities:
Client engagements:
Lead end-to-end data science projects from conceptualization through to deployment, and deploy advanced machine learning models in clients' cloud environments, optimizing for scalability, performance, and reliability to address specific business challenges and objectives
Direct clients in strategically leveraging technical models, guiding them through the interpretation of results and the integration of actionable insights into their business workflows
Solve a wide variety of complex analytical challenges for clients, at times managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
Analytical needs can include: data aggregation / creation, data cleaning / manipulation, commercial data science (e.g., geospatial, machine learning, predictive modelling, NLP, GenAI etc.), and visualizations
Drive the technical roadmap needed to support client engagements
Analytical apps, service lines, and proprietary data assets:
Drive the development of state-of-the-art analytical apps, leveraging up-to-date machine learning algorithms to solve complex problems
Lead collaboration with a variety of stakeholders to continuously innovate on the apps, service lines and proprietary data assets on offer
Set direction on developing analytical tools, service lines, and proprietary data assets, and build these areas directly when applicable
Uphold best-in-class standards in app development, data integrity, and ensuring solutions are both scalable and maintainable
Client / business development:
When relevant, support Managing Directors in developing and delivering client proposals where advanced data and analytics are critical to the scope of work
Provide input into training / upskilling the D&A team provides to Managing Directors to ensure they are aware of all current capabilities
Capability development:
Stay up to date on best-in-class software, tools, and techniques to ensure clients receive best-in-class solutions
Drive commercialization and upskilling of staff on relevant software, tools and techniques
Own the technical roadmap to ensure the Data & Analytics function operates at a best-in-class level
Mentor team members, contribute to technical capabilities of the team
cond_0017.requirements:
Degree in a quantitative and/or business discipline preferred, examples include: Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics
A minimum of 4 years of experience in applied data science with a solid foundation in machine learning, statistical modeling, and analysis
Strong knowledge, experience, and fluency in a wide variety of tools including Python with data science and machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), Spark, SQL; familiarity with Alteryx and Tableau preferred
Technical understanding of machine learning algorithms; experience with deriving insights by performing data science techniques including classification models, clustering analysis, time-series modeling, NLP; technical knowledge of optimization is a plus
Expertise in developing and deploying machine learning models in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) with a deep understanding of cloud services, architecture, and scalable solutions (e.g., Sagemaker, Azure ML, Kubernetes, Airflow)
Demonstrated experience with MLOps practices, including continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) for ML, model versioning, monitoring, and performance tracking to ensure models are efficiently updated and maintained in production environments
Hands-on experience with manipulating and extracting information on a variety of large both structured and unstructured datasets; comfort with best data acquisition and warehousing practices
Experience with commercial business analytics; experience at a consulting firm / agency is a plus
Proficient Excel, PowerPoint presentation and excellent communication skills, both written and oral; ability to explain complex algorithms to business stakeholders
Ability to achieve results through others; experience and proven success record working in matrix, agile and fast-growing environments; and assertive, intellectually curious and continuously driving towards excellence

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team.
[Company name masked]'s Data & Analytics function is focused on creating and deploying capabilities to support business results for our clients. The team includes data scientists, data engineers, technical business analytics consultants, and product managers who work together to solve some of the most challenging business problems our clients face. Together, the team covers the full analytics life cycle on client engagements: scoping and understanding business challenges, developing and maintaining robust data assets, creating and running analytical techniques, and generating visualizations to communicate findings and recommendations. We build and maintain tools and applications for use across projects and for specific clients. We also coach, mentor, and train colleagues across the business on everything from what types of commercial problems analytical techniques can help solve to in-depth technical training for specific types of analysis.
This role is for a Senior Data Scientist on a rapidly growing Data & Analytics team. The primary focus is to contribute technical expertise: working with others to execute complex analytics across a wide variety of client engagements, helping to build tools and applications that address clients' commercial issues, supporting the execution of analytical techniques, contributing to technical roadmaps for the function and firm, and training colleagues.
As part of a growing team, there is every opportunity to take on value-added work and develop your skills and experience. You will receive training across a variety of domains and work with the organization to adopt new methods for solving our clients' hardest questions. You will work at the intersection of data science and commercial business understanding, across a variety of domains, to help deliver analytically driven recommendations to our clients.
Data & Analytics is one of four key pillars of the Solutions Team, alongside Market Insights, Information & Research Center, and Knowledge Management. The Solutions team works together to support and enable our consulting team members to generate strong insights for our clients.
cond_0477.responsibilities:
Client engagements:
Coordinate end-to-end data science projects from conceptualization through to deployment, and work with client teams to deploy advanced machine learning models in their cloud environments, optimizing for scalability, performance, and reliability to address specific business challenges and objectives
Support clients in strategically leveraging technical models, helping them interpret results and integrate actionable insights into their business workflows
Work alongside colleagues to solve a wide variety of complex analytical challenges for clients, sometimes balancing multiple client engagements at one time
Analytical needs can include: data aggregation / creation, data cleaning / manipulation, commercial data science (e.g., geospatial, machine learning, predictive modelling, NLP, GenAI etc.), and visualizations
Help shape the technical roadmap needed to support client engagements
Analytical apps, service lines, and proprietary data assets:
Contribute to the development of analytical apps, leveraging up-to-date machine learning algorithms to solve complex problems
Work with a variety of stakeholders to continuously improve the apps, service lines, and proprietary data assets we can offer
Share technical expertise and contribute to developing analytical tools, service lines, and proprietary data assets, and help build these areas directly when applicable
Uphold strong standards in app development, data integrity, and ensuring solutions are both scalable and maintainable
Client / business development:
When relevant, support Managing Directors in developing and delivering client proposals where advanced data and analytics are central to the scope of work
Contribute to training and upskilling that the D&A team provides to Managing Directors to ensure they are aware of our most current capabilities
Capability development:
Stay current on software, tools, and techniques to ensure we can provide clients with strong solutions
Support commercialization and upskilling of staff on relevant software, tools, and techniques
Help shape the technical roadmap to ensure we are running a strong Data & Analytics function
Mentor team members and contribute to the technical capabilities of the team
cond_0477.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
A minimum of 4 years of experience in applied data science with a solid foundation in machine learning, statistical modeling, and analysis
Strong knowledge, experience, and fluency in Python with data science and machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), Spark, and SQL
Technical understanding of machine learning algorithms; experience with data science techniques including classification models, clustering analysis, time-series modeling, and NLP
Expertise in developing and deploying machine learning models in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) with a solid understanding of cloud services, architecture, and scalable solutions (e.g., Sagemaker, Azure ML, Kubernetes, Airflow)
Demonstrated experience with MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model versioning, monitoring, and performance tracking
Hands-on experience manipulating and extracting information from large structured and unstructured datasets; comfort with data acquisition and warehousing practices
Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint with strong written and oral communication skills; ability to explain complex algorithms to business stakeholders
Ability to achieve results through others; experience working in matrix, agile, and fast-growing environments
Preferred Requirements:
Degree in a quantitative and/or business discipline such as Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, or Economics
Familiarity with Alteryx and Tableau
Technical knowledge of optimization
Experience with commercial business analytics; experience at a consulting firm or agency is a plus

cond_0488.responsibilities:
Client engagements:
Lead end-to-end data science projects from conceptualization through to deployment, and deploy advanced machine learning models in clients' cloud environments, optimizing for scalability, performance, and reliability to address specific business challenges and objectives
Support clients in strategically leveraging technical models, guiding them through the interpretation of results and the integration of actionable insights into their business workflows
Solve a wide variety of complex analytical challenges for clients, sometimes dynamically balancing multiple client engagements at one time
Analytical needs can include: data aggregation / creation, data cleaning / manipulation, commercial data science (e.g., geospatial, machine learning, predictive modelling, NLP, GenAI etc.), and visualizations
Help drive the technical roadmap needed to support client engagements
Analytical apps, service lines, and proprietary data assets:
Drive the development of state-of-the-art analytical apps, leveraging up-to-date in machine learning algorithms to solve complex problems
Collaborate with a variety of stakeholders to continuously innovate on the apps, service lines and proprietary data assets we can offer
Provide technical expertise and thought leadership on developing analytical tools, services lines, and proprietary data assets, and contribute to building these areas directly when applicable
Uphold best-in-class standards in app development, data integrity, and ensuring solutions are both scalable and maintainable
Client / business development:
When relevant, support Managing Directors in developing and delivering client proposals where advanced data and analytics are critical to the scope of work
Provide input into training / upskilling the D&A team provides to Managing Directors to ensure they are aware of all of our most current capabilities
Capability development:
Stay up to date on best-in-class software, tools, and techniques to ensure that we are able to provide clients with best-in-class solutions
Support commercialization and upskilling of staff on relevant software, tools and techniques
Help drive the technical roadmap to ensure we are operating a best-in-class Data & Analytics function
Mentor team members, contribute to technical capabilities of the team
cond_0488.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative and/or business discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred — examples include: Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics
Minimum 4 years of demonstrated expertise in applied data science with a strong foundation in machine learning, statistical modeling, and analysis
Deep knowledge of a wide variety of tools including Python with data science and machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), Spark, and SQL
Advanced knowledge of machine learning algorithms, with proven expertise in data science techniques including classification models, clustering analysis, time-series modeling, and NLP
Extensive expertise in developing and deploying machine learning models in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), with a strong command of cloud services, architecture, and scalable solutions (e.g., Sagemaker, Azure ML, Kubernetes, Airflow)
Demonstrated track record with MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model versioning, monitoring, and performance tracking to ensure models are efficiently updated and maintained in production
Substantial hands-on experience manipulating and extracting information from large structured and unstructured datasets, with solid understanding of data acquisition and warehousing best practices
Exceptional communication skills, both written and oral, including the ability to explain complex algorithms clearly to business stakeholders; strong command of Excel and PowerPoint
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in Alteryx and Tableau
Advanced knowledge of optimization techniques
Proven experience with commercial business analytics; background at a consulting firm or agency is a strong plus
Demonstrated ability to achieve results through others, with a proven success record working in matrix and agile environments; assertive, intellectually curious, and continuously driving towards excellence

cond_0575.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join [Company name masked]'s Data & Analytics team.
[Company name masked]'s Data & Analytics function is focused on creating and deploying capabilities to drive business results for clients. The team is comprised of data scientists, data engineers, technical business analytics consultants, and product managers who work together to solve some of the most challenging business problems clients have. The team drives the full analytics life cycle on client engagements: scoping and understanding business challenges, developing and maintaining robust data assets, creating and running innovative analytical techniques, generating compelling visualizations to communicate findings and recommendations. The team builds, develops, and maintains innovative tools and applications for use across projects and for specific clients. The team also coaches, mentors and trains colleagues from across the business, on everything from what types of commercial problems analytical techniques can help solve to in-depth technical training for specific types of analysis.
The primary focus of this role is to provide technical expertise: executing on complex analytics across a wide variety of client engagements, building innovative tools and applications that help solve clients' commercial issues, executing cutting edge analytical techniques, driving technical roadmaps for the function and firm, and training colleagues.
There is every opportunity to carve out value-added work and grow your skills and experience. You will receive training in a variety of domains and lead the organization in adopting new and innovative methods to solve clients' hardest questions. You will intersect between data science and commercial business understanding, across a variety of domains, to deliver analytically driven recommendations to clients.
Data & Analytics is one of four key pillars to the Solutions Team at [Company name masked], alongside Market Insights, Information & Research Center and Knowledge Management.
cond_0575.responsibilities:
Client engagements:
Lead end-to-end data science projects from conceptualization through to deployment, and deploy advanced machine learning models in clients' cloud environments, optimizing for scalability, performance, and reliability to address specific business challenges and objectives
Direct clients in strategically leveraging technical models, guiding them through the interpretation of results and the integration of actionable insights into their business workflows
Solve a wide variety of complex analytical challenges for clients, at times managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
Analytical needs can include: data aggregation / creation, data cleaning / manipulation, commercial data science (e.g., geospatial, machine learning, predictive modelling, NLP, GenAI etc.), and visualizations
Drive the technical roadmap needed to support client engagements
Analytical apps, service lines, and proprietary data assets:
Drive the development of state-of-the-art analytical apps, leveraging up-to-date machine learning algorithms to solve complex problems
Lead collaboration with a variety of stakeholders to continuously innovate on the apps, service lines and proprietary data assets on offer
Set direction on developing analytical tools, service lines, and proprietary data assets, and build these areas directly when applicable
Uphold best-in-class standards in app development, data integrity, and ensuring solutions are both scalable and maintainable
Client / business development:
When relevant, support Managing Directors in developing and delivering client proposals where advanced data and analytics are critical to the scope of work
Provide input into training / upskilling the D&A team provides to Managing Directors to ensure they are aware of all current capabilities
Capability development:
Stay up to date on best-in-class software, tools, and techniques to ensure clients receive best-in-class solutions
Drive commercialization and upskilling of staff on relevant software, tools and techniques
Own the technical roadmap to ensure the Data & Analytics function operates at a best-in-class level
Mentor team members, contribute to technical capabilities of the team
cond_0575.requirements:
Degree in a quantitative and/or business discipline preferred, examples include: Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics
A minimum of 4 years of experience in applied data science with a solid foundation in machine learning, statistical modeling, and analysis
Strong knowledge, experience, and fluency in a wide variety of tools including Python with data science and machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), Spark, SQL; familiarity with Alteryx and Tableau preferred
Technical understanding of machine learning algorithms; experience with deriving insights by performing data science techniques including classification models, clustering analysis, time-series modeling, NLP; technical knowledge of optimization is a plus
Expertise in developing and deploying machine learning models in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) with a deep understanding of cloud services, architecture, and scalable solutions (e.g., Sagemaker, Azure ML, Kubernetes, Airflow)
Demonstrated experience with MLOps practices, including continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) for ML, model versioning, monitoring, and performance tracking to ensure models are efficiently updated and maintained in production environments
Hands-on experience with manipulating and extracting information on a variety of large both structured and unstructured datasets; comfort with best data acquisition and warehousing practices
Experience with commercial business analytics; experience at a consulting firm / agency is a plus
Proficient Excel, PowerPoint presentation and excellent communication skills, both written and oral; ability to explain complex algorithms to business stakeholders
Ability to achieve results through others; experience and proven success record working in matrix, agile and fast-growing environments; and assertive, intellectually curious and continuously driving towards excellence

Lead end-to-end data science projects from conceptualization through to deployment, and deploy advanced machine learning models in clients' cloud environments, optimizing for scalability, performance, and reliability to address specific business challenges and objectives
Support clients in leveraging technical models, providing interpretation of results and documentation of actionable insights for integration into their business workflows
Work through a wide variety of complex analytical challenges across client engagements, sometimes handling multiple projects at one time
Analytical needs can include: data aggregation / creation, data cleaning / manipulation, commercial data science (e.g., geospatial, machine learning, predictive modelling, NLP, GenAI etc.), and visualizations
Contribute to the technical roadmap needed to support client engagements
Analytical apps, service lines, and proprietary data assets:
Lead development of analytical apps, applying current machine learning algorithms to solve complex problems
Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to iterate on apps, service lines, and proprietary data assets
Provide technical input on developing analytical tools, service lines, and proprietary data assets, and contribute to building these areas directly when applicable
Uphold standards in app development, data integrity, and ensuring solutions are both scalable and maintainable
Client / business development:
When relevant, support Managing Directors in developing and delivering client proposals where advanced data and analytics are central to the scope of work
Provide input into training materials the D&A team delivers to Managing Directors to keep them informed of current capabilities
Capability development:
Stay current on software, tools, and techniques to ensure clients receive up-to-date solutions
Support commercialization and upskilling of staff on relevant software, tools, and techniques
Contribute to the technical roadmap to maintain a strong Data & Analytics function
Mentor team members and contribute to the technical capabilities of the team
cond_0646.requirements:
Degree in a quantitative and/or business discipline preferred, examples include: Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics
A minimum of 4 years of experience in applied data science with a solid foundation in machine learning, statistical modeling, and analysis
Strong knowledge, experience, and fluency in a wide variety of tools including Python with data science and machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), Spark, SQL; familiarity with Alteryx and Tableau preferred
Technical understanding of machine learning algorithms; experience with deriving insights by performing data science techniques including classification models, clustering analysis, time-series modeling, NLP; technical knowledge of optimization is a plus
Expertise in developing and deploying machine learning models in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) with a deep understanding of cloud services, architecture, and scalable solutions (e.g., Sagemaker, Azure ML, Kubernetes, Airflow)
Demonstrated experience with MLOps practices, including continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) for ML, model versioning, monitoring, and performance tracking to ensure models are efficiently updated and maintained in production environments
Hands-on experience with manipulating and extracting information from a variety of large structured and unstructured datasets; comfort with data acquisition and warehousing practices
Experience with commercial business analytics; experience at a consulting firm / agency is a plus
Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting; ability to explain complex algorithms to business stakeholders
Ability to deliver results; experience working in matrix and agile environments; intellectually curious and focused on continuous improvement

cond_0647.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join [Company name masked]'s Data & Analytics team.
[Company name masked]'s Data & Analytics function is focused on creating and deploying capabilities to drive business results for clients. The team is comprised of data scientists, data engineers, technical business analytics consultants, and product managers who work together to solve some of the most challenging business problems clients have. The team drives the full analytics life cycle on client engagements: scoping and understanding business challenges, developing and maintaining robust data assets, creating and running innovative analytical techniques, generating compelling visualizations to communicate findings and recommendations. The team builds, develops, and maintains innovative tools and applications for use across projects and for specific clients. The team also coaches, mentors and trains colleagues from across the business, on everything from what types of commercial problems analytical techniques can help solve to in-depth technical training for specific types of analysis.
The primary focus of this role is to provide technical expertise: executing on complex analytics across a wide variety of client engagements, building innovative tools and applications that help solve clients' commercial issues, executing cutting edge analytical techniques, driving technical roadmaps for the function and firm, and training colleagues.
There is every opportunity to carve out value-added work and grow your skills and experience. You will receive training in a variety of domains and lead the organization in adopting new and innovative methods to solve clients' hardest questions. You will intersect between data science and commercial business understanding, across a variety of domains, to deliver analytically driven recommendations to clients.
Data & Analytics is one of four key pillars to the Solutions Team at [Company name masked], alongside Market Insights, Information & Research Center and Knowledge Management.
